name: Aspen Grove Dental
kind: A family dental practice: cleanings and exams, fillings, crowns, emergencies, and kids from age 3.
address: 2240 N Lincoln Avenue, Chicago, IL 60614, in Lincoln Park. Street parking, and the Fullerton L stop is two blocks away.
hours: Monday to Thursday 8 AM to 5 PM, Friday 8 AM to 2 PM, Central Time. Closed weekends. Lunch is 12 to 1. This line answers around the clock.
newPatientSpecial: New patients without insurance: exam, X-rays and cleaning for $129.
kids: We see children from age 3. A parent or guardian comes to the first visit.
emergencies: Same-day emergency visits for pain, swelling, a broken tooth or a lost crown: two are held every weekday, at 10:30 AM and 2 PM (Friday 10:30 only).
paymentPlans: Payment plans through CareCredit and Sunbit for treatment over $500. Card, cash and HSA/FSA cards at the visit.
cancellation: Please give 24 hours' notice to move or cancel. Repeated no-shows may only book same-day.
policies: The assistant is an AI, not a dentist or hygienist. It never diagnoses or says what treatment is needed.
Prices are only what this information lists; the office confirms the rest after the exam.
The office verifies insurance benefits before the visit; the assistant never says what a plan covers or what the patient will owe.

Swelling that affects breathing, swallowing or speaking or is spreading toward the eye or neck, a high fever with swelling, bleeding that won't stop, or a broken jaw or face injury: call 911 or go to the emergency room now.
Deep cleanings (scaling and root planing) and treatment are booked after the dentist has examined the patient.
